mapper.select: SELECT t1.BALH_CO , t1.BALH_NM , t1.TR_STOP_GB , t1.SOSOK_GB , t1.AEKM , t1.GR_BALH_GB , TO_CHAR(t1.BUDO_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS budo_ymd , t1.COMP_CD , t1.GYUL_MM , t1.ISIN_CD , t1.COMP_BU , t1.BALH_NATION , t1.ENC_BUBIN_NO , DECODE(t1.DEL_YN, 'Y', 'Y', '0') AS del_yn , TO_DECRYPTS(t1.enc_bubin_no) AS bubin_no , 1 AS p_visible FROM sjx0jb t1 WHERE NVL(t1.SOSOK_GB, '%') LIKE #{sosokGb} AND LENGTH(t1.balh_co) > #{cdLen} ORDER BY DECODE(t1.DEL_YN, 'Y', 'Y', '0') ASC, t1.balh_co ASC

SELECT BALH_CO , TO_CHAR(YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ymd , CHG_COLUMN , BF_DATA , AF_DATA , NVL(SKT0BU, 'N') AS skt0bu , UPD_USER FROM sjx0jb_history WHERE balh_co = #{balhCo} ORDER BY chg_column ASC, ymd ASC
